scripts/start-smto-manual.sh

Shell · Tier B

Launch only the public SMTO manual on loopback port 8013 by default.

Usage

./scripts/start-smto-manual.sh [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--reload]

Inputs

SMTO_MANUAL_PYTHON or repository .venv; AOR_MANUAL_HOST/PORT/RELOAD.

Side effects

exec replaces the launcher with one manual Uvicorn process.

Cleanup

Signals and exit status belong to that process; no other service is owned.

@see src/manual/cli.py
